subject: Re: Quick on-site micro-demo during Kiosk Health road trip
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@kioskhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@kioskhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kiosk visit next week — possible 30m slot?

Hi Lukas,

Our field team will be in San Diego next Wednesday (11/25) for a set of on-site check-ins. Travel ended up tighter than expected — would you be able to swing a 30-minute demo and walkthrough of the Redwood inference flow at our office that afternoon? Alyssa and I are both available between 1:00–4:00pm PT but we can be flexible.

If 30 minutes is too short, we could do a quick 15-minute highlight instead; main ask is to see latency/cost tradeoffs and live Q&A with an engineer.

I attached our travel itinerary in case that helps with logistics.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Head of Infrastructure — Kiosk Health
[t] 415-555-0183
[attachment: KioskHealth-site-itinerary.pdf]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@kioskhealth.com>
Cc: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@kioskhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kiosk visit next week — possible 30m slot?

Hi Taylor — great to hear your team will be in SD. I can do 30 minutes but want to make sure we set expectations so you get the right people/time. Quick proposal: 20-minute focused micro-demo (real traffic sample + brief perf numbers) + 10-minute live Q&A. I can cover routing/fallbacks and how caching helps in prefix-heavy customer flows.

I looped in Ben (solutions) and Grace (AE) to coordinate coverage and recording. If you prefer a shorter highlight, we can trim to 15 with a follow-up async recording.

Proposed slot: 3:00–3:30pm PT on Wed 2026-11-25. Does that work?

I've attached a 15/20 minute agenda so your engineers know the walkthrough flow. If 3pm doesn't work we can shift to 2:00 or 3:45, but Ben would need to confirm availability.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[l] redwood.ai | calendly.com/lukas-redwood
[attachment: micro-demo-agenda-15min.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kiosk visit next week — possible 30m slot?

Thanks for the heads-up — I can cover 2:00pm or 3:00pm but I'm out from 3:30–4:30. If we lock 3:00–3:30 that gives Lukas the full micro-demo and we can record. Note: I won't have access to the dedicated testing dataset at the office; suggest we demo with a canned traffic trace that mirrors Kiosk's typical short conversations.

Grace — should I send a calendar invite to Taylor and Alyssa for 3:00 or do you want to handle routing through your cadence? Also, I'll bring a short checklist for pre-demo validation (network / local firewall allowances).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions (Field) — Redwood Inference
[t] 650-555-0130

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@kioskhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@kioskhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kiosk visit next week — possible 30m slot?

All — 3:00–3:30pm PT on 11/25 works for us. Appreciate the recording; our ops lead (Alyssa) asked that you capture the CLI commands and the perf table for our SREs. If possible, please share the recording and a quick list of commands after the session.

Also — small update: our on-site window has a customer walk-by at 3:20pm for about 10 minutes. If you hit that timing we might lose Alyssa briefly. If you're able to keep the demo lean (start with the perf table and jump to a short live query) that would help. Otherwise we can reconvene for a 15-minute post-demo sync.

I'll accept the calendar invite once Grace sends it. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Taylor
Head of Infrastructure — Kiosk Health
[t] 415-555-0183
